## desc

Intersection observer blocker

## purpose

Delay a child entry animation until its first observed intersection within the configured observation root.

## behavior

Observes matching targets in each child subtree and blocks entry on their showing readiness promise. Hiding before first appearance cancels the pending showing callback and makes the next attempt wait briefly.

## prerequisites

Use framework elements exposing onReady and trigger as matched targets, with IntersectionObserver available. target selects within each child; the default :scope targets that child itself.

## lifecycle

Removed targets are unobserved and their entry blockers are removed. Style teardown disconnects its intersection and child observers.

## composition

Apply to a parent and give its targets an animation.entry style. The styled parent is the observation root by default; set option.root to null to observe against the browser viewport.

## caveats

This gates the first showing event; it is not a repeated scroll-reveal animation. The child filter controls observed mutations, so keep the initial children and target matches compatible with framework readiness methods.
